Needs changes before merge.

The code review found no blocking code defect. The first catalog run failed two required tests. The same command passed on bare main. The retry on this head also passed. The result is intermittent; it does not prove a code regression. The requested all-green condition is not met.

What looks good:
- An absent pitch range becomes the single stated pitch. An explicit zero stays subject to the existing sanity check.
- The dovetail tolerance is small. The new test also refuses wider necks.
- The new library tests use the existing test binary. The decision file explains the compatibility choice.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local validation used upstream/main `d94b9816d55043e3a578dea490f6f7d3be31d154`. Main is already an ancestor of the PR head. The local trial merge is `101b491db89f641aa47f54e2091a93a0592825d7`. Its first parent is the reviewed head. Its tree is identical to the PR tree. No GitHub runner was used.

Results:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 16 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. The suites passed 531 tests.
- tools: lib 148; tap_hand 2.
- sim: undercut_fixture_envelope 3.
- motion: golden_undercut 4.
- app: lib 307; contour_dxf_sketch 4; mcp_undercut_fixture 3; plasma_cut_data 3; pocket_no_adaptive 4; sinker_electrode_body 7; sketch_project 14; tool_library 25; tool_reservations_version 2; units_migrate 5.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. The 11 light tests passed: motion lib 7; adaptive_troch_island 1; adaptive_troch_neck 1; adaptive_troch_parallel 1; app pocket_pass_start 1.
- An earlier light run was void because I recorded the local trial merge during its build. The complete retry used a fixed HEAD and passed.

Extra suites run:
- `example_catalog`: first run 41 passed, 2 failed, 4 ignored. Both failures were the 60 s limit for `catalog_3d_rough_finish::{rebuilds,regenerates}`.
- The same command on bare upstream/main passed: example_catalog 43; example_catalog_adaptive 1; example_catalog_edge_work 1; thread_mill 8; thread_mill_rim 13. The 3D cases took 23.436 s and 23.030 s.
- The retry on the PR head passed the same five suites: 66 tests passed; 4 ignored. The 3D cases took 21.801 s and 19.223 s.
- The command was `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog --test example_catalog_adaptive --test example_catalog_edge_work --test thread_mill --test thread_mill_rim`.
- The diff changes no test-data directory or importer. The extra importer suites do not apply.

Safety checks and mutations:
- I removed the missing-range fallback in a temporary copy. `an_unstated_range_reads_as_the_one_stated_pitch` failed. Restoring it passed.
- I set the dovetail tolerance to zero in a temporary copy. `a_neck_that_meets_the_flank_exactly_is_accepted` failed. Restoring it passed.
- Both tests passed before the mutations and after restoration. The review worktree source was not changed.
- Goldens moved: none. No recorded NC or CL file changed. The undercut golden suite passed.
- No UI file changed. Screenshots do not apply. No full heavy lane ran; this P6 issue requires none.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:311`: Resolve the intermittent catalog timeout, or provide the matching failure on bare main. Both 3D cases failed on the first PR-head run. Bare main did not fail. The retry passed, but it does not remove the recorded failure under the requested all-green rule. Check the cause before changing the test budget.

The first run reported:
```
3d/rough-finish rebuilds: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model
3d/rough-finish regenerates: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model
```

The worktree and its build artifacts remain in `.claude/worktrees/review-3965`. No source change, screenshot, log, or review evidence was committed to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I withdraw the requested change in my earlier review: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3965#issuecomment-7152865302.

Previous finding:
1. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:311` — resolved by new test evidence. The requested catalog command passed on this unchanged head. The `catalog_3d_rough_finish::rebuilds` case took 23.798 s. The `regenerates` case took 23.104 s. Both are below the unchanged 60 s limit. The maintainer explicitly requested this re-review and withdrawal if the command passed. No code fix or test-budget change was needed. This run does not establish the cause of the earlier intermittent timeout.

The code review found no new blocker. The missing-range reader keeps the narrow one-pitch range. An explicit zero remains subject to the sanity check. The dovetail test accepts the converted inch sizes and refuses wider necks.

Local validation:
- Reviewed head: `d94b3f7e852ea68c5766e26d88f67f3ab343a012`.
- Current upstream/main: `707dac12a85f9744640ef2f682fd5653f1fa83b9`.
- Trial merge: `9bc20ce09844b3afd269b09434c0f5dec779375a`. Its first parent is the reviewed head.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=16 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 16 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. The suites passed 531 tests.

- app: lib 307; contour_dxf_sketch 4; mcp_undercut_fixture 3; plasma_cut_data 3; pocket_no_adaptive 4; sinker_electrode_body 7; sketch_project 14; tool_library 25; tool_reservations_version 2; units_migrate 5.

I cleared only this worktree's target directory. The complete gate then passed with target seeding disabled. No source changed between these attempts.

Extra suites run:
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog --test example_catalog_adaptive --test example_catalog_edge_work --test thread_mill --test thread_mill_rim`: passed on its first run in this review.
- example_catalog: 43 passed, 4 ignored. example_catalog_adaptive: 1 passed. example_catalog_edge_work: 1 passed. thread_mill: 8 passed. thread_mill_rim: 13 passed. Total: 66 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- The catalog timeout did not recur. A new bare-main timeout comparison was therefore not needed.
- No fixture directory or importer changed. The extra importer suites do not apply.

Safety checks and mutations:
- In a temporary tools-crate copy, I replaced `t.pitch_min = t.pitch` with `t.pitch_min = 0.0`. `an_unstated_range_reads_as_the_one_stated_pitch` failed with the expected assertion. Restoration passed.
- In that copy, I set `NECK_MEETS` to zero. `a_neck_that_meets_the_flank_exactly_is_accepted` failed with the expected dovetail refusal. Restoration passed.
- Each mutation had a passing control before the change and after restoration. Both mutations ran in this review. The review worktree source stayed unchanged.
- Goldens moved: none. No recorded NC or CL file changed. The four undercut golden tests passed.
- No PR change touches the UI. Screenshots do not apply. The body has `Process change: yes`; `PROCESS_VERSION` is unchanged.
- No heavy lane ran. The four catalog heavy tests remain ignored. The earlier light-gate result remains in the prior review; I did not repeat that lane.

Requested before merge: none.

The PR is MERGEABLE. The author is qsmits, so I leave its draft status unchanged. The review worktree and branch remain in place to retain the build artifacts. No runner was used. No review evidence was committed to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Left for the maintainer: feat PR waiting for the next minor cut (heading `feat(tools)`), merges at the cut, not before.

Answer to the review request on the catalog timeout. The head is unchanged: `d94b3f7e8`. No code changed.

**1. The PR does not touch the path of this case.**
- The case `3d/rough-finish` (`examples/catalog/3d/rough-finish/`) holds a 3D Pocket and two 3D Finish operations. It has no thread mill, no undercut cutter and no `.camtools` file. A search of the case folder for `thread`, `undercut`, `camtools` and `dovetail` finds nothing.
- The PR changes only: `crates/tools/src/thread_mill.rs` (pitch range), `crates/tools/src/undercut.rs` (neck tolerance), `crates/tools/src/catalog_asset.rs` (`.camtools` reading), `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` (read of undercut words), their tests, one decision file and one skill file.
- It changes nothing in `crates/motion`, `crates/cl`, `crates/sim` or the 3D generators. The toolpath generation of the case is the same code on main and on the head.

**2. Earlier sightings of this failure.** The same 60 s limit failed under load on PR #3458 (load average about 130, `rebuilds` over by 0.11 s). The open issue #3163 reports it for the case `2d/adaptive-pocket`.

**3. Measurement on a separate 6-core Windows machine** (debug test binary of `example_catalog`, filter `catalog_3d_rough_finish`; main `d94b9816d`, head `d94b3f7e8`; logs `catalog-3965-v2-head-d94b3f7e8.log` and `catalog-3965-v2-main-d94b9816d.log`). Times are `regenerates` / `rebuilds`.

| Load | Main | PR head |
|---|---|---|
| idle, 5 runs | 28.7-28.9 s / 29.2-29.4 s | 28.8-29.1 s / 29.2-29.4 s |
| 6 busy loops, run 1 | 56.0 / 46.3 s | 56.7 / 41.6 s |
| 6 busy loops, run 2 | **60.0 s, FAIL** / 40.6 s | 39.6 / 59.4 s |
| 6 busy loops, run 3 | 56.1 / 43.1 s | 39.9 / 59.3 s |

- Idle, main and head are the same within 0.3 s.
- The failure reproduces on bare main under load: `3d/rough-finish regenerates: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model`.
- Under the same load, the head ended at 59.3 s and 59.4 s without failing. The spread between runs is larger than the difference between main and head.
- Note: a first set of runs used a copied test executable without its `assets` folder. The `regenerates` test failed there on the machine file, not on time. I ran all of it again with an assets link. The table is from the second set. The first set gave the same idle times.
- The review machine (16 jobs) gave 23.4 s and 23.0 s on main. The first failure on the head was therefore a loaded run, not a regression of the head.

**4. Tracking issue:** #3975 "example_catalog: catalog_3d_rough_finish nears its 60 s budget and fails under load". I cannot set labels. Please ask a collaborator for: `P7`, `effort:low`, `area:build`, `source:agent`. The maintainer decides the fix (heavy lane, smaller model, or a budget with margin). I did not change the budget in this PR.

The PR stays ready. Ready for a re-check.
